summary: Spruce Biosciences filed an 8-K reporting entry into an underwriting agreement for a public offering of 1,150,000 shares at $50.00 per share plus pre-funded warrants for 50,000 shares at $49.99 per warrant, with gross proceeds of approximately $69 million. The offering was made under an existing S-3 shelf registration and closed on April 22, 2026. Underwriters Leerink, Guggenheim, and Oppenheimer acted as representatives. The warrants have a 4.99% beneficial ownership blocker. This is a routine capital raise via an underwritten shelf takedown, not a special-situation transaction.
